title: Hydra Medium 4.0 Preparation
author: Rob Steele
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z4jf8un

steps.title: Fill tank with water
steps.instruction: Fill the Nalgene tank with 100 L of high‑purity water (Nanopure, MilliQ, or equivalent) using the tank’s volume markings to confirm the volume.

steps.title: Add sodium bicarbonate
steps.instruction: Add 4.2 g sodium bicarbonate to the tank and mix well with a plastic paddle.

steps.title: Add potassium chloride
steps.instruction: Add 0.22 g potassium chloride to the tank and mix well with a plastic paddle.

steps.title: Add magnesium sulfate
steps.instruction: Add 3.97 g anhydrous magnesium sulfate to the tank and mix well with a plastic paddle.

steps.title: Add calcium chloride
steps.instruction: Add 14.7 g calcium chloride dihydrate to the tank and mix well with a plastic paddle.
